text: I'm so sorry to bother you this late, I know you must be really busy. My daughter is 3 and her temperature is 37.7. One of her eyes has gone pink and it's sticky, there's crusty stuff on the lashes. I checked her all over for a rash and there's nothing at all, I even did the glass test on a little red mark on her leg just to be sure and it went pale straight away. I'm probably worrying over nothing but I didn't know if the eye needs drops or if I should keep her off nursery. Sorry again
